person.canonical_name_en: Carl August, Grand Duke of Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach

activity.notes: Inherited ducal title in May 1758 as minor; Anna Amalia was regent until 1775. Carl August was simultaneously Duke of Saxe-Weimar and Saxe-Eisenach in personal union; do not imply he independently governed in childhood or that these formally merged before September 1809.

sources.title: Rulers.org — German states before 1945, Weimar and Eisenach
sources.citation_text: Carl August held Saxe-Weimar and Saxe-Eisenach since 1758 in personal union (Anna Amalia regent until September 1775), united Duchy from September 1809, and Grand Duchy from April 1815.

sources.title: Wissen.de historical lexicon — Karl August, Herzog von Sachsen-Weimar
sources.citation_text: Duke from 1758, initially under mother Anna Amalia's guardianship until 1775; Grand Duke 1815–1828.

spatial_disposition.evidence: Historically distinct pre-1815 ducal office of Duchy of Saxe-Eisenach in 1758–1809, source reviewed. Exact Production Polity identity, continuity, and PlaceFunction UUIDs are unavailable during 402; do not create duplicate state or invent spatial UUID.
